notes: The API projects cell isolation from the same provider-neutral catalog that already owns region/AZ/cell topology, preserving cloud-provider-agnostic and on-prem/colo hosting goals.
No provider SDK, credential, live endpoint, or network mutation was introduced.
The regression asserts that capacity, utilization, and raw HSM partition references are not leaked through CloudAzRecord isolation evidence.
OpenAPI/data-class updates mark all new evidence fields as PUBLIC and keep richer operational internals outside this surface.
GitHub queue/merge remains post-review only: open PR, wait for oya-pr-review and required checks, then enable next-queue/auto-merge.

known_gaps.reason: No credentialed/live KR-Chuncheon, on-prem KR-Seoul, or colo inventory endpoint was contacted; this slice proves deterministic catalog-backed API projection only.
The Cloud region catalog remains the deterministic in-memory source in tests; live inventory reconciliation and runtime topology source binding are not claimed here.

rollback: Revert this ChangeSet to remove the Cloud AZ cell-isolation evidence API projection, OpenAPI schema updates, IP/P01 status updates, audit-chain row, and evidence files.

findings: AZ list now projects the cells registered for the requested AZ and targeted/full Cloud region tests pass.
Regression fixture registers two cells and asserts exact evidence while proving internal capacity/utilization/HSM partition refs stay absent.
Projection stays inside Cloud region API/domain contracts and uses the existing provider-neutral catalog, with no provider SDK or live runtime dependency.
OpenAPI CloudAzRecord now requires cell_isolation_evidence and defines a public evidence schema aligned with Rust fields.
Small helper functions reuse existing label patterns for region/AZ state and residency labels.
Deterministic cell-isolation:// evidence refs give later live-smoke/audit correlation handles without exposing secrets.
API output excludes capacity, utilization, raw HSM partition refs, credentials, provider endpoints, and network-derived data.
Cold-path catalog projection filters cells for one requested region/AZ; no hot-path benchmark claim is made.
The evidence record is derived from existing CloudCell fields and does not duplicate independent topology state.
Rollback is bounded to one API projection/test, one OpenAPI schema, plan status, and evidence/audit files.
IP/P01 status distinguishes API-green from live topology smoke pending.
Regression specifically checks for absence of capacity, utilization, and raw HSM values in debug/API evidence output.
Oya VCS claim was accepted for the exact symbols/files; queue/merge remains explicitly post-review only.
Oya VCS verify, done, and promote were accepted for the claimed IP-005 scopes; GitHub queue/merge remains post-review only.
Evidence includes TDD red, targeted/full tests, fmt, clippy, planning-closure, OpenAPI parity, API semver, data-class, and diff hygiene.
Evidence includes canonical oya verify --ci-required PASS 89/89 lanes after a documented transient disk-space failure, plus dependency-seam and audit-chain replay passes.
The change avoids a separate special-case evidence endpoint by adding the evidence where callers already list AZs and cell refs.
The same evidence contract applies to hyperscaler, on-prem, and colo cells because it is catalog-backed and provider-neutral.
The public evidence intentionally omits operational capacity and raw HSM material, limiting leakage if exposed to tenant-facing surfaces.
Consumers can inspect per-AZ cell isolation without issuing a second call or understanding internal cell manifests.
Rejected a live-inventory smoke in this slice because credentials/runtime topology targets are a separate gate; rejected separate evidence endpoint because AZ list already owns cell refs.
All new public fields have data_class comments/OpenAPI data classes and no sensitive/internal fields are added to the API record.
